name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold weight snug at chest with elbows tucked down.
Sit hips between heels while keeping chest proud.
Drive through mid-foot and exhale on the way up.

name: 45° Machine Leg Press
cues: Keep lower back and tailbone flat against the pad.
Lower sled smoothly until knees reach ~90 degrees.
Press smoothly without locking knees hard at the top.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Brace core 360° before initiating the descent.
Track knees cleanly over second and third toes.
Control a 2-second lower; stand smoothly without rushing.

name: Tempo Box / Chair Squat
cues: Lower slowly over 3 seconds until glutes lightly tap bench.
Keep shins relatively vertical to reduce knee shear.
Stand tall by squeezing glutes without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
cues: Soften knees slightly and push hips straight back.
Keep dumbbells grazing thighs with lats engaged.
Stop once hamstrings feel stretched; drive hips forward.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Step forward until cable has light tension between legs.
Hinge hips back cleanly with a neutral spine.
Finish tall by squeezing glutes—don't hyperextend lower back.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Pull slack out of the handles before lifting.
Push the floor away with your legs while keeping chest proud.
Control the descent back to a quiet touch.

name: Weighted / Bodyweight Glute Bridge
cues: Tuck ribs down and drive evenly through both heels.
Pause 1 full second at the top with glutes squeezed.
Lower under control without arching your lumbar spine.

name: Seated Hamstring Curl
cues: Align knee joint with the machine's pivot axis.
Curl heels smoothly under the seat with a brief squeeze.
Resist the pad for 2 seconds as you extend back.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Set bench to a gentle 20–30° angle, not overly steep.
Tuck elbows ~45° from torso to protect shoulder joints.
Press smoothly up and slightly inward without clanging weights.

name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest.
Pin shoulder blades softly into the back pad.
Press evenly and control a 2-second return.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Keep palms facing each other to open shoulder space.
Pause lightly when upper arms touch the floor—no bouncing.
Press smoothly to lockout while keeping ribs grounded.

name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
cues: Keep a straight plank line from ears through heels.
Lower chest toward bench edge with elbows at 45°.
Push away firmly while spreading shoulder blades at top.

name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
cues: Plant feet firmly and keep shoulder blades retracted.
Lower bar cleanly to lower sternum with controlled tempo.
Drive bar smoothly up and slightly back toward shoulders.

name: Seated Neutral-Grip DB Overhead Press
cues: Set bench 1 notch below 90° and keep palms facing inward.
Brace abs so lower back stays flush against pad.
Press straight overhead until biceps frame your ears.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine / Angled Press
cues: Kneel on the pressing-side knee with glute squeezed.
Press along the natural 45° arc—ultra friendly on shoulders.
Reach slightly forward at the top without shrugging.

name: Scapular-Plane Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Raise arms ~30° forward of your sides (scapular plane).
Lead with elbows and stop right at shoulder height.
Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds without swinging torso.

name: Incline Shoulder Press-Up
cues: Hinge hips up into a soft inverted V position.
Lower forehead forward between hands, not straight down.
Press back smoothly until arms extend.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Rest chest flat on a 30° incline bench to unload lower back.
Drive elbows back toward hips and pause briefly at top.
Let shoulder blades stretch gently forward on the descent.

name: Seated Neutral-Grip Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with chest lifted—avoid rocking backward.
Pull handle toward lower ribs, squeezing shoulder blades.
Control the extension back to a clean stretch.

name: Bench-Braced Single-Arm DB Row
cues: Brace free hand firmly on bench with flat back.
Pull dumbbell in a sweeping arc toward your hip pocket.
Keep hips level—avoid twisting your torso open.

name: Rope Face Pull
cues: Set pulley at eye level and pull rope toward your forehead.
Finish with knuckles back and elbows high in a double-bicep pose.
Use light, controlled weight—great for posture and shoulders.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold band at shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pull hands apart until band taps mid-chest.
Keep shoulders relaxed down away from ears.

name: Seated Resistance Band Row
cues: Loop band securely around feet with knees slightly bent.
Sit tall and pull elbows cleanly past ribs.
Pause 1 second at peak contraction.

name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Use a shoulder-width neutral handle for happy shoulders.
Initiate by pulling shoulder blades down, then drive elbows to ribs.
Control the bar all the way up to a comfortable lat stretch.

name: Machine Assisted Pull-Up
cues: Choose enough assistance to complete clean, strict reps.
Lift chest toward the handles rather than craning your chin.
Lower smoothly over 2 seconds without dropping into shoulders.

name: Straight-Arm Cable / Band Pulldown
cues: Hinge slightly at the hips with arms long and elbows soft.
Sweep hands smoothly down to your thighs using your lats.
Keep ribs down—don't round forward as you pull.

name: Dumbbell Bench / Floor Pullover
cues: Keep a gentle bend in the elbows throughout the arc.
Lower dumbbell behind head only as far as ribs stay flat.
Pull smoothly back over mid-chest using your lats.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Step backward to keep front shin vertical and knee comfortable.
Lean torso slightly forward over front hip to engage glute.
Drive through front full foot to return to standing.

name: Controlled Low Box Step-Up
cues: Use a knee-friendly low step height (12–16 inches).
Drive up using only the top leg—avoid pushing off back toes.
Step down slowly over 2 full seconds.

name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cues: Rest rear laces lightly on bench; 85% of weight on front foot.
Drop straight down with slight forward torso lean.
Stand smoothly without locking out harshly.

name: Tempo Dead Bug
cues: Press lower back firmly into the floor before moving.
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly while exhaling fully.
Stop leg extension before your lower back lifts off the mat.

name: Cable / Band Anti-Rotation Pallof Press
cues: Stand sideways to anchor with soft knees and tall posture.
Press handle straight out from sternum and hold 2 seconds.
Resist the sideways pull without twisting hips or ribs.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry
cues: Walk tall with ribs stacked over hips and shoulders packed.
Take steady, quiet steps for 30–40 seconds per set.
Avoid letting dumbbells bang against your thighs.

name: Single-Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
cues: Hold one dumbbell at your side and stay tall — don't lean toward the weight.
Walk slowly for 30–40 seconds, then switch hands.
Keep ribs stacked over hips and breathe steadily.

name: Goblet Carry
cues: Hug the weight at chest height with elbows tucked.
Take short, quiet steps for 30–40 seconds per set.
Stay tall and keep your ribs from flaring.

name: World's Greatest Mobility Flow
cues: Step into a long lunge, plant opposite hand, rotate chest to sky.
Breathe deeply for 2 seconds at peak thoracic rotation.
Move smoothly side-to-side to lubricate hips and upper back.

name: Cat-Cow & Scapular Glide
cues: Inhale as you gently drop belly and lift chest forward.
Exhale as you round mid-back up toward ceiling.
Move slowly through pain-free range to warm up the spine.

name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Rest the bar on your shoulders with elbows high.
Keep your torso tall as you sit between your heels.
Drive up through mid-foot, elbows leading.

name: Sumo Goblet Squat
cues: Stand wide with toes turned out about 30 degrees.
Hold the weight at your chest and sit straight down.
Push your knees out over your toes on the way up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cues: Place your feet slightly in front of the bar.
Sit down and back, keeping your whole foot planted.
Stand tall without locking your knees hard.

name: Bench Hip Thrust
cues: Rest your upper back on the bench with feet flat.
Tuck your chin and drive your hips up until level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie back with one foot flat and the other knee hugged in.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level, with no twisting.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
cues: Soften the standing knee and hinge at the hip.
Reach the free leg straight back as your torso tips forward.
Keep your hips square to the floor, then stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Plant your feet and set your shoulder blades back and down.
Lower the dumbbells until your elbows are about 45 degrees from your sides.
Press up and slightly together without bouncing.

name: Push-Up
cues: Hands just outside your shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Press the floor away without sagging your hips.

name: Band Chest Press
cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height.
Press forward until your arms are straight, without shrugging.
Return slowly, keeping tension on the band.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cues: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press up without arching your lower back.
Lower under control to just below ear level.

name: Band Overhead Press
cues: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart.
Brace your core and press straight overhead.
Lower to shoulder height with control.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Stand side-on to the cable with a slight lean away.
Lift your arm out and slightly forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, keeping the tension steady.

name: Seated Machine Row
cues: Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding forward.

name: Band Face Pull
cues: Anchor the band at face height and step back.
Pull toward your eyes, elbows high and wide.
Hold a beat and return slowly.

name: Pull-Up
cues: Start from a dead hang with shoulders pulled down.
Drive your elbows toward your hips as your chest rises.
Lower fully under control.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
cues: Kneel or stand under the anchor with arms reaching up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Let the band lift your arms back up slowly.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Use a narrow neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, elbows in.
Control the bar back up to full arm extension.

name: Walking Dumbbell Lunge
cues: Take a long step and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking over your middle toes.
Push through the front heel to step into the next rep.

name: Bodyweight Split Squat
cues: Stand in a long stance with both feet pointing forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches.
Drive up through the front foot.

name: Forearm Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your ribs down.
Breathe steadily and stop when your form slips.

name: Thread the Needle
cues: Start on hands and knees with hips over knees.
Slide one arm under your body and rotate your upper back.
Return and reach that arm toward the ceiling.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and lean gently over the front shin.
Rotate your knees across to the other side with control.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Kneel on a pad with the other foot forward.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and tuck your pelvis.
Shift forward gently until you feel the front of your hip stretch.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
cues: Keep your elbows pinned at your sides.
Curl up without swinging your torso.
Lower for about three seconds.

name: Hammer Curl
cues: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up with elbows still, no swinging.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Band Biceps Curl
cues: Stand on the band with elbows at your sides.
Curl to your shoulders and squeeze.
Let the band lower your hands slowly.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
cues: Keep your elbows glued to your ribs.
Press down to full lockout without leaning on the stack.
Let the handle rise only to about 90 degrees at the elbow.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
cues: Anchor the band high and pin your elbows to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly without letting your elbows drift forward.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
cues: Stand tall with the balls of your feet on a step or the floor.
Rise as high as you can and pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your heels are below the step if you can.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Balance on one foot, lightly touching a wall.
Rise straight up as high as you can.
Lower slowly and keep your ankle from rolling.

name: Chin-Up
cues: Grip the bar with palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
Pull your chest toward the bar, leading with your elbows.
Lower all the way down with control.

name: Inverted Row
equipment_label: Bar at Hip Height (Smith or Rack)
cues: Hang under the bar with your body in one straight line.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly; bend your knees to make it easier.

name: Bench Dips
cues: Hands on the bench edge behind you, fingers forward.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
cues: Start tall at the top with shoulders down.
Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press up to straight arms without swinging.

name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Feet on the bench, hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest with your body in one straight line.
Press up without letting your hips sag.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
cues: Hands just inside shoulder width, elbows close to your ribs.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Press up and lock out your elbows.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from the bar with shoulders pulled down.
Raise your legs by curling your pelvis up, not swinging.
Lower slowly to a dead hang.

name: Mountain Climbers
cues: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips level and breathe steadily.

name: Jump Squat
cues: Squat to a comfortable depth with your chest up.
Jump straight up, driving through your whole foot.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under your shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold without letting your hips drop, then switch sides.

name: Superman (Locust Pose)
cues: Lie face down with arms reaching forward.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold while breathing, then lower slowly.

name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly with a tall spine.
Rotate your ribs to one side, then the other.
Keep the movement controlled; lift your feet only if it stays easy on your back.

name: Upward Salute (Urdhva Hastasana)
cues: Stand tall with feet together and weight even.
Sweep your arms overhead and lengthen through your fingertips.
Keep your ribs soft and breathe slowly.

name: Standing Side Bend
cues: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the other side.
Keep both feet grounded and hips square.
Breathe into the stretched side, then switch.

name: Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana)
cues: Hinge from your hips and let your upper body hang.
Bend your knees as much as you need.
Let your head and neck relax completely.

name: Inchworm to Downward Dog
cues: Fold forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Push your hips up and back into an upside-down V.
Press your heels toward the floor and breathe.

name: Child’s Pose (Balasana)
cues: Kneel, sit back on your heels and fold forward.
Reach your arms long or rest them by your sides.
Breathe into your back and relax your shoulders.

name: Butterfly (Baddha Konasana)
cues: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Sit tall, then fold forward gently from your hips.
Let your knees drop naturally; never push them down.

name: Seated Forward Fold (Paschimottanasana)
cues: Sit with legs straight and spine tall.
Hinge forward from your hips toward your toes.
Stop where you feel a stretch, not pain, and breathe.

name: Wide-Leg Seated Fold
cues: Sit with your legs wide and kneecaps facing up.
Walk your hands forward while keeping a long spine.
Back off if you feel it behind your knees.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
cues: Lie on your back with feet hip-width apart.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Hold with steady breath, then roll down slowly.

name: Knees to Chest (Apanasana)
cues: Lie on your back and hug both knees in.
Rock gently side to side if it feels good.
Relax your shoulders to the floor.

name: Brisk Walk or Easy Jog (Outdoors)
cues: Walk briskly enough that talking takes a little effort.
Swing your arms and stand tall.
Jog in short bursts only if it stays comfortable.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
cues: Set an incline of 5 to 10% and a brisk walking pace.
Do not hold the handrails; swing your arms.
You should be able to talk, but not sing.

name: Treadmill Run
cues: Start with 3 minutes of easy walking.
Run at a pace you could hold a short conversation at.
Land softly under your hips with short, quick steps.

name: Stationary Bike
cues: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Keep a steady cadence of about 80 to 90 revolutions a minute.
Add resistance rather than bouncing in the saddle.

name: Elliptical Cross Trainer
cues: Stand tall and push and pull the handles.
Keep your whole foot on the pedals.
Use resistance to make it work, not just speed.

name: Rowing Machine
cues: Push with your legs first, then lean back, then pull the handle in.
Reverse the order on the way back.
Keep a smooth rhythm of about 24 strokes a minute.

name: Stair Climber
cues: Stand tall and step through your whole foot.
Use the rails only lightly for balance.
Pick a pace you can hold steadily.

name: Jump Rope
cues: Turn the rope with your wrists, elbows close to your sides.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing softly.
Work in rounds: 30 to 60 seconds on, 30 seconds easy.

name: Outdoor Cycling
cues: Ride at a pace where you can still talk.
Use easier gears on hills instead of standing.
Wear a helmet and stay visible.
